# United Firefighters' Union of Australia – application for an intractable bargaining declaration

Introduction

The United Firefighters' Union of Australia (UFUA) has applied for an intractable bargaining application.

Content

On 28 July 2023 the UFUA applied for an intractable bargaining declaration (B2023/771).

The application was made under [section 234](https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2009A00028/2026-07-07/2026-07-07/text/original/epub/OEBPS/document_1/document_1.html#_Toc236384710 "Section 234") of the _Fair Work Act 2009_ in relation to the proposed Fire Rescue Victoria, United Firefighters' Union Operational Staff Agreement 2022.
